title: Weigh Your Own Words: Improving Hate Speech Counter Narrative Generation via Attention Regularization

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the quality and specificity of generated counter-narratives responding to disability-targeted hate speech using automated metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, Repetition Rate) and human evaluation.

Testing the model's ability to generalize counter-narratives against anti-Semitic (Jews) and Islamophobic (Muslims) hate speech using Leave-One-Target-Out (LOTO) experiments, attention distribution analysis, and human evaluation.
Assessing the generation of specific counter-narratives to anti-LGBT+ hate speech via attention regularization, measuring performance with n-gram overlap metrics and human rankings for suitableness.

Analyzing model attention weights on identity terms like 'migrant' and evaluating the specificity and diversity of counter-narratives generated using Kullback-Leibler Attention Regularization (KLAR) and Leave-One-Target-Out generation.
Measuring the effectiveness of attention regularization techniques in preventing lexical overfitting when generating counter-narratives to hate speech targeting People Of Color (POC).
Evaluating zero-shot generalization of the counter-narrative generation model on hate speech targeting women using the Leave-One-Target-Out (LOTO) setup and human evaluation for response specificity.
